steps.content: The hazy figures shudder violently and then scatter back into luminous specks. But they do not leave. Instead, they gather again in the air, weaving into a ribbon of light that glides toward Lichen.
The incantation has scarcely left her lips halfway when the ribbon of light winds itself around her arm. It constricts, then slips beneath her sleeve.
She freezes in place, lowering her head as if listening intently.
You take the opening to brace your hands against the slimy, softened earth and force yourself to your feet. Something hard grazes your fingertips.
Lichen raises her eyes and lets her gaze trail across the glowing ribbon wound obediently around her arm, then smiles.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Why run? These things answer to me now.
In a flash, the copper coin sears with heat, nearly hot enough to melt through your skin. Just like before, a dire warning.
As you suspected, even these drifting fish are on her side. Who is left for you to rely on?!
Gritting your teeth against the pain, you grip the copper coin hard, spin around, and sprint into the darkness at full speed.
Behind you, she turns and walks after you, bells at her waist swaying gently, ringing step by step.
Run. That's all you can do now. Keep running.
